I have read and agree to the privacy policy
No additional ad options required in your region.

Last updated: October 2026

1. Information We Collect
• Account Information: Name, email, and password to create and access your account.
• Booking Information: Selected salon, services, date, and appointment time.

2. How We Use Your Data
We use your data solely to manage your account, bookings, and improve our service. We do not sell your personal data.

3. Advertising (Google AdMob)
The app displays ads via Google AdMob. Google and its partners may use the advertising ID on your device and technical data to display and measure ads. In applicable regions, we obtain your consent via Google UMP form.

4. Data Retention and Deletion
We keep your data as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and data at any time.

5. Security
We implement reasonable technical measures to protect your data.

6. Contact Us
For inquiries: support@example.com
